item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.8
item.description: Fix: bins from 0.3.0 to 0.3.7 wouldn't open in Media Composer (STRM_UNICODE_STRING_NOT_FOUND). New bins are right, and bins it already made are fixed by themselves within a minute of updating (the old copy is kept beside each as .avb.broken). Reopen the bin in Avid after that.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.7
item.description: A failed import now says why, with a Send logs button, and when it's YouTube or Spotify that changed, an 'Update the downloader' button. If another Mac with the same computer name makes media folders in the same place, Bad MxFer warns you (their folder numbers could collide in Avid).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.6
item.description: Waiting for Avid: a 30 second bar now runs from the moment Avid has read the media, and the bin goes in as soon as it ends (it used to wait up to another 30 s, and restarted if Avid touched its files, so it could look stuck). Bins waiting for Avid also go in while another import is running. Do it now is there at every step; before Avid has read the media it puts the bin in with its clips offline until Avid catches up.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.5
item.description: New: after each update you'll see a short note like this one saying what changed. If a drive comes back as FAL_PRJ-1 after a dropped connection, Bad MxFer now says so plainly and how to fix it.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.4
item.description: Updates can now bring newer helper tools (ffmpeg, MXF writer) in parts.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.3
item.description: Opening animation: the logo sits to the right and is bigger, as in Bad MxFer POB.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.2
item.description: All-apps licences (one file opens every POB app). Queue is on the right, as in 2.3.
